title: SF462 (2025-2026 Regular): Certain retired law enforcement officers permission to carry firearms in school

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2025-01-17; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/94/2025/0/SF/462/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version (Introduction, 2025-01-17). Only new law is clause (10) in the exceptions list; paragraph (a) is existing law quoted for context. The bill's own text does not use the words 'retired officer'; section 926C is the federal retired-officer carry law.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d(a)): Except as provided under paragraphs (d) and (f), whoever possesses, stores, or keeps a dangerous weapon while knowingly on school property is guilty of a felony and may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000, or both.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.66, subd. 1d(f)(10)): (10) persons authorized to carry a firearm under United States Code, title 18, part I, chapter 44, section 926C, and who are carrying in compliance with that law.
